verdict.rationale: Synctera exposes an extensive API surface (OpenAPI spec, customer/account/card/payment/KYC endpoints) covering most core banking operations, suggesting an API-first design. However, docs also reference dashboard-only administrative functions (team admin setup, case notifications, linking external accounts) with no corresponding API endpoints mentioned, and there is no explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, evidence that admin/case-management/dashboard operations (docs-16, 26, 27, 36) are also API-accessible, and independent confirmation from a hands-on integrator.
